title: Bose Lifestyle Ultra Subwoofer gets a huge 33% price cut
summary: Bose’s new Lifestyle Ultra Subwoofer hits an all-time low of $599 on Amazon, down from its $899 RRP.
body: The Bose Lifestyle Ultra Subwoofer just dropped to $599 on Amazon, and that’s a big cut from its $899 recommended retail price. That saves you $300, and Amazon says the deal works out to 33% off RRP, making this an all-time low by a long way. See the deal at Amazon

title: Bose’s 2026 Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar is $254 off on Amazon
summary: Save 23% on Bose’s new Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar, a premium Dolby Atmos bar with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and speech boost.
body: Bose’s new Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar is a premium all-in-one home theater bar built for bigger, more movie-like sound, and there’s a strong deal on it right now on Amazon. It sits in Bose’s Lifestyle Collection and uses a redesigned acoustic setup made to deliver more immersive audio from a single enclosure. See the deal at Amazon This soundbar supports Dolby Atmos and Bose spatial processing, which helps create a wider, more enveloping surround effect without needing a full stack of separate speakers right away. Bose also places a strong focus on dialogue clarity here, with speech enhancement designed to make voices easier to understand in movies, shows, and sports. For streaming and setup options, it supports both Wi-Fi and Bluetooth and can also integrate with Bose’s multiroom audio system.
